notes.title: Small Autumn Update
notes.notes:
I’ve had the idea for a long time to create a “layered” system of events in the village that unfold between the doctor’s working days. Just like in more mature games, where a story doesn’t end with a single reward or debuff but leads into another, continuing the narrative. Now, I finally have the chance to try it out

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38767712/708db5dc14cd05e64e2b70d584368c94fa08fa59.png[/img]

The new version includes several “one-time” events and a few continuations of existing ones that can impact the game's storyline progression

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38767712/53a674d54c7d1c28fa3408ff575f38ee9d509ee7.png[/img]

Let’s consider this the beginning of something bigger - the first attempt to expand the game’s world and delve into its narrative style. This approach will eventually allow the CosCom team not only to add more levels to chosen village events but also to unlock new locations and mechanics for players

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38767712/71dafa4ca50c321c9b98ec9a2ae0f3c494eff656.png[/img]

As always, thank you for reading, downloading, and playing our game. Peace to all! :) Stay tuned for updates

notes.title: Global game update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38767712/66953c29949e3a4d85fbb3ea4be86cdd3aaa37ee.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone! Coscom here!

This time, the update covers all content, not just a couple of pesky bugs. The main idea of this release is to migrate the game to the latest engine version and add things that the developer, artist, and game designer couldn’t implement four years ago due to lack of experience, laziness, and a tight budget

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38767712/fd40793d154e1642db42993b04ded6987456964a.jpg[/img]

So, what’s been added:

- New endings. 8 new (a couple of old ones that had become stale with their repetitiveness, along with new, unique, and awesome ones)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38767712/74df4369b3b86783aa3d3e1955a8715094b0959d.jpg[/img]

- New locations. Hand-drawn in the classic style

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38767712/e9123894850f7bdf33ae423bf5e3b79fac18c3e0.jpg[/img]

- An inventory with items that directly impact the storyline

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38767712/9a3d48a53dd40eddf0b8b2cc966bedde59124378.jpg[/img]

- Minigames within minigames, so you can play minigames while playing minigames

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38767712/da6b5f933d976d06997e6fb979bb254e262a6077.jpg[/img]

- A new hardcore balance. Thought the game was easy? Pfff, hold my herbal tincture. I've played this game 100500 times over the past two months and still can't get a 100% completion every time

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38767712/0af1e092f5499bfb597b6950d0c3b2aebc5d0ec8.png[/img]

- More than 10 new achievements. Hidden and public. Collect them all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38767712/d6c049236233d98d8817c18c5163cae463b651d2.jpg[/img]

- A completely different PLAGUE!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38767712/5fd25bbb203f60eb55c6e965c4c86fd1d6a8b5b9.jpg[/img] 

- A lockpick to unlock things, and a torch to burn something

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38767712/53e5196c3abf53ee882f18cc13f72fbc2df911b2.jpg[/img]

- And, of course, new bugs. You've never seen anything like them!

Thank you to everyone who believed in our small team, downloaded the game, and played it. The studio has been given the opportunity to continue its work. We are endlessly grateful and will delight you with new unique projects in the future, which will come very soon. Stay tuned for updates! ;)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38767712/077da887c9b20a088372e51ebfdc0a5911b60c0c.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Plague discounts!
notes.notes: For everyone who did not manage to buy the game at a discount during the holidays, we are launching a 35% discount and extending the build with cosmetic changes in the New Year's style!

notes.title: For New Year's mood - to the plague village!
notes.notes:
In the festive build of Plague M.D. we have fixed some nasty bugs and optimized the application. In addition, our artists have worked on the environment in the locations of the game, adding cosmetic changes. Plague is not a reason to give up the holiday mood!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38767712/2ad6ebd97b765c4ec8b18549fbd064f1d391c169.jpg[/img]

Happy Holidays!

notes.title: New Year in the Plague Village!
notes.notes:
Happy holidays, friends!

To celebrate the best time of the year, we offer Plague M.D. with a 40% discount! Moreover, we are planning an update that will include cosmetic changes in the holiday style and fixes for a number of nasty bugs. All so that on the holidays you can enjoy a hand-drawn game without encountering bugs and glitches. We hope that defeating this terrible disease in Plague M.D. will cheer you up and empower you to overcome real adversity.

By purchasing the game now, you will support our next project, which is just a few months away from release. Thank you for being with us!

Be healthy and happy!
sincerely yours, CosCom team

Hey! Let's roll the dice! Now in Plague M.D. in the tavern, you can not only have fun, but also earn money by gambling, and if luck smiles at you, even get a new achievement.

notes.title: Plague News 5
notes.notes:

notes.title: Plague News 2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38767712/c040171223f706677c3d42eeed2aa38e10fa9d9f.png[/img]
Hello everyone!

Today is scheduled to be the release of Plague M. D.
Unfortunately, we don't know all the details of publishing games on the platform very well, and we overlooked the fact that the final version of the game should also be tested by the administration. This usually takes 3-5 days.

We would like to give you access to the game right now by launching Early Access, but since we were already aiming for the final release, this option is not available to us.

As soon as the new release date is known, we will publish the news immediately.
You won't have long to wait :)

notes.title: Plague News
notes.notes:
Hi, people! What's up?

Our team working hard on this game project. Last month we implemented tons of new features - the game become much more stable. Now we've successfully registered on Steam platform and just seen all the possibilities of Steam Workshop.

After analysing of future work we decided to change release date - 21.10.2020. More than that, release version will include:
1. New type of symptoms
2. New events
3. New quests
4. Collection items
5. Achievements 
6. New sounds and normal master' balance

It is pleasure to know, that you read our updates and believe in us. Thank you!
